Features:

Al Rigga, like other sub-communities in Deira, features a lively way of life, with an array of restaurants, malls, retail outlets, and transportation means. The area is suitable for families as well as professionals, for they will find apartments and offices in different configurations. Points of interest in the area are:
A wide range of apartments and offices
Choice of restaurants, malls, and clinics
Easy access to transportation means
PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION IN AL RIGGAAl Rigga, Deira is well-developed in terms of transportation means, which are not limited to buses only and in fact include the Dubai Metro, taxis, and cabs. 'union' Metro Station lies within the borders of Al Rigga, while many other metro stations are available in the neighboring communities. These include Baniyas Square Metro Station, Salah Al-Din Metro Station, Al Rigga Metro Station, and Abu Baker Al Siddique Metro Station. Being a transfer station, 'union' Metro Station serves both the Green and the Red Line along with being a transfer point for those commuting from Sharjah and Ajman. Moreover, it is one of the busiest metro stations in the city, for being in proximity to the Dubai Economic Department, Dubai Land Department, and other government areas.

- For Families

Al Rigga, like other sub-communities in Deira, features a lively way of life, with an array of restaurants, malls, retail outlets, and transportation means. The area is suitable for families as well as professionals, for they will find apartments and offices in different configurations. Points of interest in the area are:
A wide range of apartments and offices
Choice of restaurants, malls, and clinics
Easy access to transportation means
PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION IN AL RIGGAAl Rigga, Deira is well-developed in terms of transportation means, which are not limited to buses only and in fact include the Dubai Metro, taxis, and cabs. 'union' Metro Station lies within the borders of Al Rigga, while many other metro stations are available in the neighboring communities. These include Baniyas Square Metro Station, Salah Al-Din Metro Station, Al Rigga Metro Station, and Abu Baker Al Siddique Metro Station. Being a transfer station, 'union' Metro Station serves both the Green and the Red Line along with being a transfer point for those commuting from Sharjah and Ajman. Moreover, it is one of the busiest metro stations in the city, for being in proximity to the Dubai Economic Department, Dubai Land Department, and other government area.

The Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) is a special economic zone in Dubai covering 110 ha (272 acres), established in 2004 as a financial hub for companies operating throughout the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia (MEASA) markets. 

DIFC is regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority, an independent regulator exclusive to the zone, and by its own court system, DIFC Courts, separate from the Emirate of Dubai's legal system and that of the federal government of the UAE. [3] DIFC follows the common law framework and operates in English. 

DIFC is one of Dubai's independent free zones; it offers companies 100% ownership without the need for a local partner. The freezone houses financial institutions, and wealth funds in addition to retail and hotel space dedicated to the free zones.

About DIFC:

The Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) is a special economic zone in Dubai covering 110 ha (272 acres), established in 2004 as a financial hub for companies operating throughout the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia (MEASA) markets. 

DIFC is regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority, an independent regulator exclusive to the zone, and by its own court system, DIFC Courts, separate from the Emirate of Dubai's legal system and that of the federal government of the UAE. [3] DIFC follows the common law framework and operates in English. 

DIFC is one of Dubai's independent free zones; it offers companies 100% ownership without the need for a local partner. The freezone houses financial institutions, and wealth funds in addition to retail and hotel space dedicated to the free zones.

Exclusive Links proudly present this stylish and contemporary living experience in the heart of Dubai Marina. We are delighted to present a stunning studio fully furnished apartment available for rent at Studio One, a prestigious residential tower renowned for its exceptional quality and prime location.

Step into this thoughtfully designed studio apartment and be captivated by its modern aesthetic and functional layout. The open-plan living area offers a comfortable space for relaxation and entertainment. The tasteful furnishings, combined with abundant natural light flowing in through the floor-to-ceiling windows, create an inviting ambiance. From here, you can enjoy panoramic views of the Dubai Marina skyline, adding to the allure of this exceptional residence.

The apartment features a well-appointed kitchenette, equipped with high-quality appliances and ample storage space. Whether you're preparing a quick meal or indulging in culinary creations, this kitchenette offers convenience and functionality.


Residents of Studio One enjoy access to an impressive range of amenities. Take a refreshing dip in the rooftop swimming pool, unwind in the relaxing sauna, or maintain your fitness routine in the state-of-the-art gymnasium. Furthermore, the building offers 24-hour security, a dedicated parking space, and a friendly concierge service, ensuring a comfortable and secure living environment.

Dubai Marina is a vibrant neighborhood that offers a wealth of entertainment, dining, and leisure options. With its trendy cafes, upscale restaurants, and luxurious boutiques, you'll always find something to suit your tastes. The marina promenade is a delightful spot for leisurely walks, while the nearby beach provides a serene escape from bustling city life.

Don't miss out on the opportunity to experience luxury living in Dubai Marina. Contact us now to arrange a viewing and secure this exceptional fully furnished studio apartment at Studio One.

Dubai International City embraces the Central Business District (CBD) residential districts, Persia, Greece, Spain, Morocco, England, France, Italy, Russia, China, and the Emirates. Apart from these districts that were initially planned for Dubai International City namely Lake District and Forbidden City are now put on hold due to the effects of the Global Financial Recession. Some astounding attractions in the city include the World Famous Dragon Mart, the world's biggest machinery and equipment market. 

The Residential District:

The Residential District of Dubai international city planned to have numerous country-specific and themed residential developments and retail outlets. There will be commercial shops, restaurants, medical centers, Post offices, police stations, and transportation services. 

Location:

Dubai International City is located in the Al Warsan region of Dubai, opposite to the Dubai Central Fruit and Vegetable Market. 

Travel:

The community is serviced by the RTA bus service. 
300 Dubai International City Intercity Bus: The bus rotates frequently between the International City Clusters. 
You will require a Nol Card (Prepaid Bus/Metro Card) to avail of bus services. NOL card services are available at Spinneys, Carrefour, and Al-Ansari exchange (Dragon Mart), which will let you top up your NOL cards at International City. The same may be obtained at any Major Bus Terminus or Metro Station. 
Taxis are easily available within this community. 

About Us:

BARAKAT AL MADINA Real Estate is a luxury boutique estate agency based in Dubai. One of the city's fastest-growing real estate firms, our brand-new modern office is based in the heart of Dubai. 
We specialize in Sales and Leasing, focusing on the off-plan (primary) market. 
We are founded by well-established estate agents, who have been in the market for over a decade. 
We deliver excellent customer service, above and beyond our client's expectations, with our fresh and transparent approach. We aim to raise the bar when it comes to customer service, product knowledge, and employee retention.

enhanced_title: All-Inclusive Luxury Studio in Barsha Heights: Live Effortlessly with Free AC, WiFi & Cleaning!
enhanced_description:
Welcome to your stylish sanctuary in Barsha Heights! This fully furnished studio apartment, presented by HRT Properties LLC, offers the ultimate in convenience and comfort. Priced at AED 75,600 annually, with flexible payment options of up to 12 cheques, this all-inclusive living experience allows you to move in and immediately enjoy the vibrant Barsha Heights lifestyle.

Imagine relaxing on your private balcony, enjoying the community views after a productive day. This 420 sqft studio is designed for modern living, featuring a spacious open-plan living area, a well-equipped kitchenette with high-quality appliances and stone countertops, and a sleek bathroom with premium fixtures. Built-in wardrobes provide ample storage, and stylish flooring adds a touch of elegance.

Forget about utility bills! Your rent includes chiller-free central AC, high-speed Wi-Fi, and DEWA utilities. Plus, enjoy the luxury of twice-weekly professional cleaning, ensuring your apartment is always immaculate. With 24/7 CCTV surveillance, on-site maintenance, and power backup, your comfort and security are our top priorities.

The building offers a range of amenities to enhance your lifestyle, including high-speed elevators, a concierge service, a fully equipped gym, and landscaped recreational areas. Step outside, and you're immersed in the vibrant Barsha Heights community, with trendy cafes, eateries, supermarkets, and salons just moments away. Conveniently located near Dubai Internet City Metro (Red Line) and well-served by public transport, commuting is a breeze.

Barsha Heights is more than just a location; it's a lifestyle. As a professional hub adjacent to Dubai Internet City and Media City, it offers a village feel with circular streets, public parks, and pet-friendly walkways. Whether you're looking for a casual cafe or a lively bar, you'll find it here.

HRT Properties LLC offers a wide range of properties across Dubai, from studios to 3-bedroom apartments in Barsha Heights, Al Barsha 1, Business Bay, Dubai Marina, and JVC. Contact us today for personalized support in finding your perfect home or investment property!

Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to live in a prime location with all the amenities you could ask for!
